interpretation: Strongly supported primary contributor: host Docker image export and SSH/streamed verification CPU activity. Disk reads contributed but observed historical latency/queue/iowait do not indicate a primary disk bottleneck. Exact syscall/process causal tracing was not recorded.
known_limits: Historical CPU metrics are one-second grouped samples, not per-PID traces. SSH group may include child jobs.
Collector contributes small CPU/I/O overhead to the later live window.
Netdata negative writes/blocked values are display conventions; absolute values used for magnitudes.
Historical charts without points or HTTP404 are unavailable, never treated as zero.
No NFS-server or hypervisor investigation; guest NFS/ZFS observations are limited.
Docker stats block IO is cumulative since container start, not a 60-second delta.

metric_access.initial_chart_catalog: two bounded requests stopped at 4 MiB cap; subsequent queries use small documented context/data endpoints
